Class AFSYSTEMSelectorProvider

java.lang.Object
java.nio.channels.spi.SelectorProvider
org.newsclub.net.unix.AFSelectorProvider<AFSYSTEMSocketAddress>
org.newsclub.net.unix.darwin.system.AFSYSTEMSelectorProvider
public final class AFSYSTEMSelectorProvider extends AFSelectorProvider<AFSYSTEMSocketAddress>
Service-provider class for junixsocket selectors and selectable channels.
